p.src: 1  LORD, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.

en: LORD, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.
u.src: 1  LORD, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.

p.src: 2  Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.

en: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.
u.src: 2  Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.

p.src: 3  Set a watch, LORD, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.

en: Set a watch, LORD, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.
u.src: 3  Set a watch, LORD, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.

p.src: 4  Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.

en: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.
u.src: 4  Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.

p.src: 5  Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.

en: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.
u.src: 5  Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.

p.src: 6  Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.

en: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.
u.src: 6  Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.

p.src: 7  “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”

en: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”
u.src: 7  “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”

en: 141:7 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 8  For my eyes are on you, LORD, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul destitute.

en: For my eyes are on you, LORD, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul destitute.
u.src: 8  For my eyes are on you, LORD, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul destitute.

p.src: 9  Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.

en: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.
u.src: 9  Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.

p.src: 10  Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.

en: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.
u.src: 10  Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.
